text: This is ScopePay. It helps freelancers get paid for the work they agreed to.
If you've ever freelanced, you've heard these. That wasn't in the brief. It's not finished yet. We'll pay once we've checked. Every one of them is really an argument about evidence.
ScopePay puts the agreement, the delivered work, and the PayPal payment into one record that both sides can check.
Here's a freelancer's workspace, with one project underway.
It all starts with the signed agreement.
The AI pulls out every milestone, amount, and acceptance condition, and each one quotes the clause it came from.
Those quotes are checked word for word against the document, and nothing is used until you confirm it.
For milestone two, the designer has delivered four page screenshots. Let's run the review.
The AI checks each condition against what's actually on screen, and it catches a problem. The portfolio page, required by clause three point four, was never delivered.
caption: The AI checks each condition against what's actually on screen, and it catches a problem. The portfolio page, required by clause 3.4, was never delivered.

text: So the designer uploads the missing page, along with a corrected services page.
One more review, and now every condition is backed by evidence.
Then the client asks: can you also add a blog?
The answer is in the agreement. Clause five point one excludes a blog, so ScopePay drafts a change order, priced at the agreement's own rate of ninety-five dollars an hour.
caption: The answer is in the agreement. Clause 5.1 excludes a blog, so ScopePay drafts a change order, priced at the agreement's own rate of $95 an hour.

text: Now the evidence goes to the client.
They don't need an account. They see each screenshot next to the clause it satisfies.
And they accept by typing their name. The AI prepares the evidence, but people make the decision.
They approve the change order the same way.
And that acceptance automatically creates the PayPal invoice.
Back in the workspace, the invoice goes out through PayPal Invoicing.
When the client pays, a verified PayPal webhook marks the milestone as paid.
Every milestone lives in one payment pipeline, built with AG Grid.
And the invoice ledger gives you filters, live totals, and a CSV export for your accountant.
Under the hood, it's PayPal Invoicing with verified webhooks, AI that always cites its sources, and people in charge of every decision.
ScopePay. Agreed work, proven, and paid.
